consequence.statement: Operators upgrading to Crossplane 2.0 must configure managed resource activation policies as step 3 of the documented upgrade approach; the cited excerpt names the step but does not state what fails if it is skipped.
consequence.remediation: Follow section 3, "Configure managed resource activation policies", of the Crossplane v2 upgrade guide (upgrade-to-crossplane-v2.md) when upgrading to 2.0.0.

assertion.statement: Upgrading to Crossplane 2.0 includes an operator step to configure managed resource activation policies, listed as step 3 of the upgrade approach in the official v2 upgrade guide.
